headline_marked: Trump's envoys [[meet Putin in Moscow to discuss ending Ukraine war]]
headline: Trump's envoys meet Putin in Moscow to discuss ending Ukraine war
summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff have arrived in Russia with a peace proposal from Donald Trump to halt the five-year conflict.
details: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with US President Donald Trump's envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, at the Kremlin on Saturday. The meeting focused on finding ways to end the long-standing war in Ukraine.

To facilitate these talks, both Russia and Ukraine have committed to a three-day ceasefire in each other's capitals. The US-led effort aims to stop the conflict, which has become the most devastating in Europe since World War II.
President Putin welcomed the envoys, asking them to convey his greetings and gratitude to Donald Trump, while acknowledging that the current situation remains difficult.
The diplomatic push comes as the war enters its fifth year, with thousands killed and millions displaced. Recent months have seen an increase in civilian casualties and attacks.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy agreed to halt attacks on Moscow until Monday, while the Kremlin announced it would not attack Kyiv from Saturday midnight for three days.
Despite the ceasefire agreement, Zelenskyy alleged that Russia continued to attack Kyiv's outskirts and airports, claiming Moscow is attempting to sabotage the peace efforts.

headline_marked: Missing 7-year-old [[rescued from Shariatpur]] after being taken by stranger
headline: Missing 7-year-old rescued from Shariatpur after being taken by stranger
summary: Police tracked CCTV footage of a woman taking the child from Dhaka's Shewrapara area and arrested the suspect in Shariatpur.
details: A seven-year-old boy who went missing from East Shewrapara in Dhaka after being led away by an unknown woman was rescued by police two days later.
The child was found in the Shariatpur Padma Bridge South police station area on Saturday afternoon.
Police arrested 22-year-old Yuthi Akhtar from the location where the child was rescued.

The incident occurred on Thursday, September 3, when the child was playing near his home. His parents, whose father is a CNG driver, filed a General Diary (GD) at Kafrul Police Station after he failed to return.

Following the case, Kafrul police analyzed multiple CCTV cameras. Footage showed a woman in a black salwar-kameez taking the child's hand and leaving in a rickshaw from a lane near the Health Lab Diagnostic Center.
Kafrul Police Station OC Saifull Islam noted that the way the child held the woman's hand suggested he may have known her previously.
After the child was received primary medical treatment, he was reunited with his parents. A detailed investigation into the case is ongoing.
